reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Birch Juice Moisturizing Pad 80ea Double Pack
reviews.text: Plenty of liquid in it - better to use it as a moisterising mask.
reviews.zh: 入面有好多液體——用嚟做保濕mask更好。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Birch Juice Moisturizing Pad 80ea Double Pack
reviews.text: These sheet mask rounds are so nice! Perfect for moisturizing during the day when you don't have time for a whole sheet mask. Very moisturizing and easy placement. I will buy these again for sure!
reviews.zh: 呢啲圓形sheet mask真係好正！日間冇時間敷成塊mask嘅時候用嚟保濕就啱晒。非常保濕，又容易貼服。一定會再買！

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Birch Juice Moisturizing Pad 80ea Double Pack
reviews.text: They’re great for calming sensitive skin and adding quick moisture, especially in the morning or before makeup. I didn’t expect how great it was going to be; I took it off, and my skin felt so smooth! I applied makeup after, and it went on so well in the areas I put it. My skin feels refreshed, calm, and deeply hydrated every time I use them. They seem to take away the tiredness from my face. My skin can get very dry sometimes, so I use this toner pad when I need extra hydration. This is the second time I’ve bought it and got it to restock for the wintertime and also when my skin is desperate for intense hydration. It will last you a long time.
reviews.zh: 佢哋好啱舒緩敏感肌同即時補水，尤其係朝早或者化妝前用。原本冇expect會咁好用；撕走之後皮膚滑到爆！之後再上妝，敷過嘅位上面超貼。每次用完皮膚都感覺煥然一新、平靜又深層保濕。感覺用完面上嘅疲憊都消失埋。我間中皮膚會好乾，所以需要額外補水嘅時候我就會用呢塊toner pad。今次係第二次買，入返貨準備冬天用，亦都係皮膚極度缺水嘅時候用。呢件產品可以用好耐。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Birch Juice Moisturizing Pad 80ea Double Pack
reviews.text: Ordered birch juice toner pads for 3-4th time it’s calming and cooling my skin and moisturizes also.I use it after washing my face in morning routine before serum cream etc or in evening if want to cool down skin.I love them so much and they’re soaked in essence so they’ll not dry fast and good packaging
reviews.zh: birch juice toner pad已經訂咗第3-4次，佢可以舒緩、降溫同保濕皮膚。喺朝早洗完面、搽精華同cream之前用，或者晚上想幫皮膚降溫嘅時候用。我勁鍾意，佢哋浸滿精華所以唔會好快乾，包裝都唔錯。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Birch Juice Moisturizing Pad 80ea Double Pack
reviews.text: These moisturizing cotton pads are super hydrating! They’re great for my nighttime skincare or to prep my face before makeup. They make my skin feel so comfortable, and this is definitely a product I’ll always keep using.
reviews.zh: 呢啲保濕棉pad超級補水！夜晚護膚或者化妝前用嚟打底都好啱。用完皮膚好舒服，呢款產品我一定會keep住用落去。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Birch Juice Moisturizing Pad 80ea Double Pack
reviews.text: The only toner pads that I've bought more than once. I've been through at least 20 of them. Size is perfect. Not too small or too big. Sticks to face really well. Lifesaver for both dry winters and hot summer days
reviews.zh: 係唯一一款我買過多過一次嘅toner pad。已經用過至少20塊。大細啱啱好，唔會太大又唔會太細。好貼面。乾爽冬天同炎熱夏天都係救星。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Birch Juice Moisturizing Pad 80ea Double Pack
reviews.text: My 3rd tub of these pads. They're a nice round size. Comes with plenty of serum. Cooling and moisturising. I have veru dry, sensitive skin and these don't sting. The tweezers it comes with is also good.
reviews.zh: 已經係第3桶。圓形size幾好。有好多精華。涼浸浸又保濕。我皮膚非常乾又敏感，用呢啲都唔會吉。附送嘅鉗都幾好用。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Birch Juice Moisturizing Pad 80ea Double Pack
reviews.text: I had a sample of this toner pads and I really fell in love with them so I immediately ordered them when was sale.They’re not sticky not oily doesn’t have any smell.Suits very sensitive and dehydrated skin.Calming cooling effect.Skin feels relived after and very hydrated and glowing.I also have birch juice moisturizer,ampoule and cleanser.
reviews.zh: 我之前有試過呢款爽膚水棉片嘅 sample，真係一試愛上，所以減價嘅時候即刻落單。完全唔黏笠、唔油笠、冇任何味道。啱晒敏感肌同極度缺水嘅皮膚。有舒緩同涼浸浸嘅感覺。用完之後皮膚感覺放鬆咗，仲好保濕、好有光澤。我亦有買樺樹汁保濕乳、安瓶同潔面乳。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
